author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing had round ears on a single head outline, two dot eyes and splayed legs, so it read as a bear or mouse. Redrawn after the reference: a domed hairdo with round buns on top, side hair falling straight to the bottom corners, and the face set inside the hair under a fringe of two curls meeting in a V. No dot eyes, so it no longer reads as an animal.
omissions: The heart-shaped bang tuft, the eye ticks and the smile were dropped: the fringe curls leave no 8-unit room above or inside the face.
